name: The Catch mascot
description: What's the Catch?'s own character: the viewer's stand-in who tries things, gets into trouble and reacts, in every Short. Big curly hair, a teal hoodie, tan trousers and white sneakers, drawn blended into the channel's worlds (look C: navy lines, warm colours, the scene's light on his edge). He never speaks; the narrator tells the story. Picked by Biku on 2026-10-21 from four designs (design 1). His name is still to be chosen.
